description: Pin-based annotation overlay for design review — wraps any content and adds interactive comment pins with pluggable persistence

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON file containing pin data (an array, or { pins }). A newer value aborts an older in-flight request; removing it, or assigning .pins / importPins(), aborts a pending request (removing it mid-load falls back to the adapter)

attributes.name: editable
attributes.description: Enables annotate mode toolbar and pin creation

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Default author name for new pins

events.name: review-surface:upgraded
events.description: Fired once, on first connect, after the adapter is resolved and before the initial pin load. Not re-fired when the element is moved.

events.name: review-surface:ready
events.description: Fired once, after the initial pins (from src, the adapter, or a pre-connect .pins assignment) have loaded and rendered. Not re-fired on later renders.

events.name: review-surface:add
events.description: Fired when a pin is created (annotate-mode click or addPin())

events.name: review-surface:update
events.description: Fired when a pin is modified (reply added, text set, re-opened)

events.name: review-surface:remove
events.description: Fired when a pin is deleted

events.name: review-surface:resolve
events.description: Fired when a pin is marked resolved

events.name: review-surface:select
events.description: Fired when a pin popover is opened

events.name: review-surface:pins-changed
events.description: Fired after a .pins assignment (not for adapter loads or addPin())
